topics.purpose: Define each AccessCore authorization policy as an explicit canonical identity with exact subject/resource/operation applicability and effect semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant policy has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.resource_rule: Applicable resource scopes are exact canonical refs/pattern semantics.
semantics.priority_rule: Policy combination/preference semantics are explicit and never file order.
semantics.ownership_rule: Policy does not take ownership of protected resource.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
